---
title: "Sector Explorer"
---

Trees were sampled across three lagoon sectors — **upper**, **lower**, and **main creek** — plus a handful of offshore caye sites not yet shown on this map. Click a sector below to see its structure: species mix, species importance, trunk diameter (DBH) and height distributions, and the underlying tree-level data. To see biomass by individual field station instead, visit [Sampling Points](sampling-points.qmd).

## Lagoon sectors

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
trees = FileAttachment("data/dataset.json").json()
sectorSummary = FileAttachment("data/sector-summary.json").json()
speciesComposition = FileAttachment("data/species-composition.json").json()
sectorsGeo = FileAttachment("data/placencia-sectors-map.geojson").json()
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorLabels = ({upper: "Upper", lower: "Lower", "main creek": "Main Creek"})
sectorColors = ({upper: "#2c7bb6", lower: "#d7191c", "main creek": "#1a9641"})
speciesPalette = ["#1b9e77", "#d95f02", "#7570b3", "#e7298a", "#66a61e", "#e6ab02", "#a6761d"]
speciesNames = [...new Set(trees.map((d) => d.species))].sort()
speciesColor = (species) => speciesPalette[speciesNames.indexOf(species) % speciesPalette.length]
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
mutable selectedSector = null
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Defined (and displayed, as the live map container) in this same cell:
// a separate cell that only *references* mapDiv would show a generic
// object inspector instead of embedding the live DOM node.
mapDiv = html`<div id="sector-map"></div>`
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
L = require("leaflet@1.9.4")
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
map = {
  const m = L.map(mapDiv, { scrollWheelZoom: false }).setView([16.62, -88.34], 12);
  L.tileLayer("https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png", {
    attribution: '&copy; <a href="https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright">OpenStreetMap</a>',
    maxZoom: 19,
  }).addTo(m);
  return m;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Sector polygon layer, built once. Hover state is tracked with a plain
// closure variable (not a reactive `mutable`) so hovering never re-triggers
// the layer rebuild — only clicks notify the rest of the page, via
// `mutable selectedSector`.
sectorGeoLayer = {
  let activeRegion = null;

  function baseStyle(region) {
    return {
      color: "#555",
      fillColor: sectorColors[region] ?? "#ccc",
      weight: 2,
      fillOpacity: 0.45,
    };
  }

  const layer = L.geoJSON(sectorsGeo, {
    style: (f) => baseStyle(f.properties.region),
    onEachFeature: (feature, lyr) => {
      const region = feature.properties.region;
      lyr.bindTooltip(sectorLabels[region] ?? region, { sticky: true, direction: "top" });
      lyr.on({
        mouseover: (e) => e.target.setStyle({ weight: 3, fillOpacity: 0.65 }),
        mouseout: (e) => {
          if (activeRegion !== region) e.target.setStyle(baseStyle(region));
        },
        click: (e) => {
          activeRegion = region;
          mutable selectedSector = region;
        },
      });
    },
  });
  layer.addTo(map);
  return layer;
}
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
// Reactive pass: re-applies the "selected" emphasis whenever selectedSector
// changes, without rebuilding the layer.
{
  sectorGeoLayer.eachLayer((lyr) => {
    const region = lyr.feature.properties.region;
    const selected = region === selectedSector;
    lyr.setStyle({
      weight: selected ? 4 : 2,
      fillOpacity: selected ? 0.75 : 0.45,
    });
  });
}
```

### Structure: DBH & height distributions

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
sectorTrees = trees.filter((d) => d.sector === selectedSector)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
//| output: false
speciesImportance = {
  if (selectedSector == null) return [];
  const sectorTreeRows = trees.filter((d) => d.sector === selectedSector);
  const stationCount = new Set(sectorTreeRows.map((d) => d.station_id)).size;
  const totalTrees = sectorTreeRows.length;
  const totalBasalArea = sectorTreeRows.reduce((sum, d) => sum + d.dbh_cm ** 2, 0);

  const bySpecies = new Map();
  for (const tree of sectorTreeRows) {
    const row = bySpecies.get(tree.species) ?? {
      species: tree.species,
      n: 0,
      basalArea: 0,
      stations: new Set(),
    };
    row.n += 1;
    row.basalArea += tree.dbh_cm ** 2;
    row.stations.add(tree.station_id);
    bySpecies.set(tree.species, row);
  }

  return [...bySpecies.values()]
    .map((row) => ({
      species: row.species,
      dominance: (100 * row.basalArea) / totalBasalArea,
      frequency: (100 * row.stations.size) / stationCount,
      density: (100 * row.n) / totalTrees,
    }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.dominance - a.dominance);
}
```

### Species importance

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
{
  if (selectedSector == null) {
    return html`<p class="sector-hint">No sector selected yet.</p>`;
  }

  const size = Math.min(560, Math.max(300, width - 20));
  const margin = Math.max(52, Math.min(78, size * 0.14));
  const domain = 1.5;
  const axes = [
    { key: "dominance", angle: Math.PI / 2 },
    { key: "frequency", angle: Math.PI / 2 + (2 * Math.PI) / 3 },
    { key: "density", angle: Math.PI / 2 + (4 * Math.PI) / 3 },
  ];

  const pointFor = (row, axis) => {
    const r = row[axis.key] / 100;
    return {
      species: row.species,
      axis: axis.key,
      value: row[axis.key],
      x: r * Math.cos(axis.angle),
      y: r * Math.sin(axis.angle),
    };
  };

  const points = speciesImportance.flatMap((row) => axes.map((axis) => pointFor(row, axis)));
  const lines = speciesImportance.flatMap((row) => {
    const rowPoints = axes.map((axis) => pointFor(row, axis));
    return [...rowPoints, rowPoints[0]];
  });
  const grid = [25, 50, 75, 100].flatMap((level) => {
    const r = level / 100;
    const ring = axes.map((axis) => ({ level, x: r * Math.cos(axis.angle), y: r * Math.sin(axis.angle) }));
    return [...ring, ring[0]];
  });
  const spokes = axes.flatMap((axis, i) => [
    { axis: i, x: 0, y: 0 },
    { axis: i, x: Math.cos(axis.angle), y: Math.sin(axis.angle) },
  ]);
  const pxPerUnit = (size - 2 * margin) / (2 * domain);
  const lineGap = 18 / pxPerUnit;
  const labels = [
    { x: 0, y: 1.2, text: "Relative dominance (%)", anchor: "middle" },
    { x: -0.98, y: -0.56 + lineGap / 2, text: "Relative", anchor: "end" },
    { x: -0.98, y: -0.56 - lineGap / 2, text: "frequency (%)", anchor: "end" },
    { x: 0.98, y: -0.56 + lineGap / 2, text: "Relative", anchor: "start" },
    { x: 0.98, y: -0.56 - lineGap / 2, text: "density (%)", anchor: "start" },
  ];

  const colorDomain = speciesImportance.map((d) => d.species);
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    width: size,
    height: size,
    marginTop: margin,
    marginRight: margin,
    marginBottom: margin,
    marginLeft: margin,
    axis: null,
    x: { domain: [-domain, domain], axis: null },
    y: { domain: [-domain, domain], axis: null },
    color: { domain: colorDomain, range: colorDomain.map((d) => speciesColor(d)) },
    marks: [
      Plot.line(grid, { x: "x", y: "y", z: "level", stroke: "#e5e5e5", strokeWidth: 1 }),
      Plot.line(spokes, { x: "x", y: "y", z: "axis", stroke: "#d8d8d8", strokeWidth: 1 }),
      Plot.line(lines, { x: "x", y: "y", z: "species", stroke: "species", strokeWidth: 2, strokeOpacity: 0.9 }),
      Plot.dot(points, { x: "x", y: "y", fill: "species", stroke: "#fff", strokeWidth: 1, r: 3 }),
      Plot.text(labels.filter((d) => d.anchor === "middle"), {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        textAnchor: "middle",
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "#444",
      }),
      Plot.text(labels.filter((d) => d.anchor === "end"), {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        textAnchor: "end",
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "#444",
      }),
      Plot.text(labels.filter((d) => d.anchor === "start"), {
        x: "x",
        y: "y",
        text: "text",
        textAnchor: "start",
        fontSize: 11,
        fill: "#444",
      }),
    ],
  });

  const legend = speciesImportance
    .map(
      (d) =>
        `<span class="radar-legend-item"><span class="radar-swatch" style="background:${speciesColor(
          d.species
        )}"></span>${d.species}</span>`
    )
    .join("");

  return html`<div class="radar-block">
    <div class="radar-plot">${plot}</div>
    <div class="radar-legend">${legend}</div>
    <p class="radar-note">All axes are relative (%). Grid rings mark 25%, 50%, 75%, and 100%. Dominance is the share of summed DBH² (basal-area proxy), frequency is the share of stations where the species occurs, and density is the share of trees.</p>
  </div>`;
}
```
